notes: Google Doc comments were NOT included in the .docx export. Actions come from agentAction + salesforce.macro fields.
mandatory_fraud_questions: When and how did you first notice this issue?
If you received any codes from KYC providers for Tamara account creation recently, were they shared with someone else? If yes, why?
Do you suspect someone might have access to your personal information?
Have you lost your physical ID card or phone recently? If yes, please share more details.
Have you ever shared your information with someone claiming to be from a government entity or a financial institution recently?
Do you want to block the account temporarily until the investigation is complete?

national_identity_fraud.critical_security_rule: CRITICAL: DO NOT share any account details (names, phone numbers) until the customer has uploaded their ID snippet.
national_identity_fraud.primary_questions_rule: Must answer at least 2 primary questions correctly
primary_questions: Date of Birth (Exact Gregorian/Hijri as per CS Panel — do not use online Hijri converters)
Contact number customer is trying to register on / contacted by agency
secondary_questions: Last payment method + last 4 digits of card
Date of last placed order or installment
Total amount of last placed order or last installment paid
mandatory_evidence: A clear photo/snippet of their National ID to confirm legal ownership
Screenshot of the error on Tamara App or screenshot of the account interface

scenarios.title: ID is Not Registered in Tamara
scenarios.condition: Search with National ID in CS Hub returns 0 records.
scenarios.agent_action: Inform the customer that their ID is not linked to any Tamara account. Advise them never to share OTPs, ID numbers, or account details.

salesforce.issue_type: Account > Account Security > National ID Fraud
salesforce.case_comment_resolution_type: National ID Fraud > ID Not Found

scenarios.title: ID Not in Tamara but in SIMAH (Recognized Phone)
scenarios.condition: ID exists in SIMAH records under Tamara/Nakhalah, and the customer recognizes the registered phone number.
scenarios.agent_action: Advise customer that this reflects their registered activity. Advise never to share OTPs or credentials.

salesforce.issue_type: Account > Account Security > National ID Fraud
salesforce.case_comment_resolution_type: National ID Fraud > ID Not Found < Present in SIMAH (Known Phone number)

scenarios.title: ID in SIMAH (Unrecognized Phone - Potential Fraud)
scenarios.condition: ID exists in SIMAH, but customer does NOT recognize the phone number.
scenarios.agent_action: Potential fraud. Administer the 6 Mandatory Fraud Questions. Escalate immediately without resolving.

salesforce.issue_type: Account > Account Security > National ID Fraud
salesforce.case_comment_resolution_type: National ID Fraud > ID Not Found < Present in SIMAH (Unrecognized Phone number)

scenarios.title: Recycled Phone Number Issue
scenarios.condition: National ID not in Tamara, but the customer's phone number is registered under another account.
scenarios.agent_action: Inform them the number is tied to an existing profile. Administer 6 Mandatory Fraud Questions and escalate.

salesforce.issue_type: Account > Account Security > National ID Fraud
salesforce.case_comment_resolution_type: National ID Fraud > Recycled Phone Number

scenarios.title: ID Linked - Customer Recognizes User (Family / Friend)
scenarios.condition: Snippet received. Disclosed First Name and Last 4 of phone on file + last shipping address. Customer recognizes the party.
scenarios.agent_action: Allow continued account use. If access is lost due to lost phone, guide to Account Recovery (KSA Absher) or Manual Phone Change (UAE).

salesforce.issue_type: Account > Account Security > National ID Fraud
salesforce.case_comment_resolution_type: National ID Fraud > Family/ Friendly Account Sharing

scenarios.title: ID Linked - Customer Does NOT Recognize User
scenarios.condition: Snippet received. Customer confirms zero knowledge of account details or orders.
scenarios.agent_action: Potential identity theft. Administer 6 Mandatory Fraud Questions and escalate to Trust & Safety.

salesforce.issue_type: Account > Account Security > National ID Fraud

order_fraud.topic: Order Fraud / Unrecognized Charge on Account

scenarios.title: Order Status is Inactive / Expired
scenarios.condition: CS Hub > Customer Detail > Histories > Order Status is Expired / Cancelled.
scenarios.agent_action: Provide User First Name and Last 4 of Phone on shipping info. Explain that the order is inactive with 0 liability. Educate on not sharing OTPs.

salesforce.issue_type: Payment > Unrecognized charge > Explained to customer (no issue)

scenarios.title: Order Status is Active (Approved / Authorised / Captured)
scenarios.condition: CS Hub order is active and customer does not recognize the order or recipient.
scenarios.agent_action: Ask Order Fraud questionnaire (Q1-Q9: When did it happen? How was ID leaked? Why was Absher OTP given? Who was caller? Police report filed?). Escalate to Trust & Safety.

scenarios.title: Deduction Matches Customer's Own Account
scenarios.condition: Charge found in CS Hub Payment Dashboard matching customer's own order installment.
scenarios.agent_action: Confirm order ID and store details. Explain installment schedule to customer.

salesforce.macro: Transaction made on the customer account
salesforce.issue_type: Payment > Unrecognized charge > Explained to customer (no issue)

scenarios.title: Card Charged on Another Customer's Account
scenarios.condition: Card deduction exists on a third-party Tamara account.
scenarios.agent_action: STRICT PRIVACY: Do NOT share any details of the other account. Advise customer to check with family/friends, contact their bank to freeze the card, and file an unauthorized charge dispute.

salesforce.issue_type: Payment > Unrecognized charge > Explained to customer (no issue)

scenarios.title: Customer Requests Card Removal from Other Account
scenarios.condition: Customer requests Tamara to manually detach their stolen card from another person's account.
scenarios.agent_action: Inform customer Tamara cannot manually delete payment methods from third-party accounts. Push back to issuing bank.

salesforce.macro: Cannot Remove Card From Another Account

mandatory_evidence: Screenshot of customer's valid National ID
Soft copy of telecom service/purchase contract (first service date must be recent and postdate original Tamara account creation date)
Screenshot from Tawakkalna / Absher app showing phone number verified under their National ID

scenarios.title: Awaiting Telecom Contract / Verification Evidence
scenarios.condition: Customer has not yet provided all 3 mandatory documents.
scenarios.agent_action: Request National ID, Telecom Contract, and Tawakkalna/Absher verification screenshot.

salesforce.macro: Phone No. archiving - Ask for evidence
salesforce.issue_type: Account > Registration & Login > Phone number already in use

scenarios.title: Evidence Validated -> Unlink Account
scenarios.condition: All 3 documents match and telecom contract date confirms recent ownership transfer.
scenarios.agent_action: Attach documents and contract dates to SF Case Comment. Escalate to Trust & Safety.

salesforce.issue_type: Account > Registration & Login > Phone number already in use

scenarios.title: Name, DOB, or 1-2 ID Digits Typo Correction
scenarios.condition: Legitimate owner with OCR typo in first/last name, incorrect DOB, 1-2 wrong digits, minor spelling variation, or legal name change.
scenarios.agent_action: Compare National ID screenshot with CS Hub. Add Customer ID, mismatch breakdown, and ID screenshot to case comments. Escalate to Tech Support.

bnpl_plus_cooling_off.topic: BNPL+ / Pay By Finance Policy & Cooling-Off Rules

scenarios.title: Full Order Cancellation Within 14-Day Cooling-Off
scenarios.condition: Order cancelled in full <= 14 days from Order Approval Date.
scenarios.agent_action: 100% full refund: Principal amount + Processing Fee + Accrued Murabaha Profit/Service Fee are all refunded/reversed.

salesforce.issue_type: Refunds and Cancellations > How to return or cancel an order or item

scenarios.title: Full Order Cancellation After 14-Day Cooling-Off
scenarios.condition: Order cancelled in full > 14 days from Order Approval Date.
scenarios.agent_action: Principal is 100% refunded. Processing fee is NON-REFUNDABLE. Customer must pay accrued Murabaha profit for the days the contract was active.

salesforce.issue_type: Refunds and Cancellations > Late Refund > Refund already processed

scenarios.title: Partial Order Cancellation (Any Time)
scenarios.condition: Customer returns only part of the order at any time.
scenarios.agent_action: Principal adjusted via installment rescheduling. Processing fee is NON-REFUNDABLE. Accrued Murabaha profit is NEVER refunded for partial returns.

salesforce.macro: BNPL+ (Partial refund) - adjusted amount more than what's paid
salesforce.issue_type: Refunds and Cancellations > Late Refund > Refund already processed
